title: Adapting DNNs to Embrace Voltage Scaling Induced Errors via Accumulation-Aware Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2610.33824v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The pervasive deployment of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) across the computing spectrum has brought growing attention to energy efficiency, alongside raw performance. While voltage scaling is a potent knob for power reduction, its application in next-generation nodes is hampered by severe throughput degradation and susceptibility to process variation. This work aims to address these energy-reliability trade-offs by introducing a hardware-software co-design methodology, based on the observation that timing-robust bit ranges within the accumulator of a systolic array vary significantly across different voltage-frequency operating points. At the software level, we propose an Accumulation-Aware Training approach that incorporates this information as a first-order optimization constraint during training. translated_title: 通过感知累加的量化方法使深度神经网络适应电压缩放引起的误差
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络在计算领域的广泛部署，使人们在关注原始性能的同时，越来越重视能效问题。虽然电压缩放是降低功耗的有效手段，但其在下一代工艺节点中的应用受到严重的吞吐量下降以及对工艺偏差敏感性的阻碍。本工作旨在通过引入一种软硬件协同设计方法来解决这些能量与可靠性之间的权衡问题，其核心观察是：脉动阵列累加器中对时序鲁棒的位范围在不同的电压-频率工作点之间存在显著差异。在软件层面，我们提出了一种感知累加的训练方法，将该信息作为训练过程中的一阶优化约束。通过将混合精度量化与非结构化剪枝相结合，我们有效地约束了模型的权重分布，以避免激活（摘要原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出一种软硬件协同设计方法，通过感知累加的训练将脉动阵列在不同电压-频率工作点下的时序鲁棒位范围信息作为优化约束，并结合混合精度量化与非结构化剪枝，使深度神经网络能够容忍电压缩放引入的计算误差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hardware-software co-design methodology that incorporates timing-robust bit range variations across voltage-frequency operating points as first-order optimization constraints via accumulation-aware training, combined with mixed-precision quantization and unstructured pruning, enabling DNNs to tolerate voltage scaling induced errors.
